newsitem.title: MEXICO: Televisa has 40.5 pct ownership in PanAmSat.
newsitem.headline: Televisa has 40.5 pct ownership in PanAmSat.

text.p: Grupo Televisa S.A., said Thursday it has a 40.5 percent stake in PanAmSat, which announced an agreement earlier in the day to merge its satellite services operations with Hughes Electronics Corp.
The company said its shares represent a 40.5 percent ownership in PanAmSat.
Televisa said it expects to receive about $600 million in cash and an equity interest of about 8.5 percent in the new venture between PanAmSat and Hughes.
Televisa also said it will buy back PanAmSat's rights to purchase equity stakes in Televisa's Spanish broadcasting ventures in the Americas and Spain. Televisa said this is valued at $225 million.
"This mutually beneficial transaction enables us to realize substantial value from our net investment of $160 million in PanAmSat," said Televisa Chief Financial Officer Guillermo White.
